tooltip_policy.revenue: Tooltip shows: measure value, weight (units), units, weighted price, provenance (derived)
tooltip_policy.scenario: Tooltip shows: measure value, scenario run name, provenance (simulated)
tooltip_policy.risk: Tooltip shows: risk score, risk tier, risk rank, top contributing components (from risk_components jsonb text)
tooltip_policy.forecast: Tooltip shows: forecast_value, lower_bound, upper_bound, model_name, provenance (derived)

delta.positive_bad: excess days / stockout units increase = red up-arrow (worse)
delta.positive_good: service level / fill rate increase = green up-arrow (better)

undefined_state: All numeric measures that resolve to BLANK() render the literal '-' via the 'Display Dash' measure. No fabricated 0.
empty_table_state: When a visual's filter context returns zero rows, show an explicit 'no data for selection' message; never an automatic zero.
